epic.spec:
# Data Table Panel Improvements

Comprehensive improvements to the Data Table panel including bi-directional selection sync with the map, themed dropdown styling, ID format changes, azimuth simplification, and visual polish.

## Overview

The Data Table panel currently operates independently from the rest of the application. This epic adds:
- Bi-directional selection sync between DataTable and Map/Sections Panel
- Themed dropdown styling using existing Select component
- User-friendly ID format (sectionId:shotPosition instead of internal IDs)
- Single azimuth column with circular mean calculation
- Row hover/selection styling
- Enhanced keyboard navigation (Enter/Shift+Enter)
- Proper edge case handling for deletions
- Screen reader support

## Scope

**In scope:**
- DataTable.tsx component enhancements
- EditableTable.tsx enhancements (row interactions, scroll, keyboard nav)
- DetailPanel.tsx ID format updates
- Shared utility extraction (circularMeanDegrees, formatShotId)
- Column width fixes
- ARIA announcements

**Out of scope:**
- Backend changes
- New database fields
- Export functionality changes

## Approach

### Key Patterns to Follow

1. **Selection state** - Use existing `uiStore.selection`, `hoveredShot` states
   - Pattern at `src/store/uiStore.ts:56-99`
   
2. **Row styling** - Follow SectionsPanel pattern
   - Pattern at `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx:218-219`
   - `isSelected || hoveredSectionId === section.id ? 'bg-accent/20' : 'hover:bg-accent/20'`

3. **Map panning** - Use existing fitToSection/easeTo patterns
   - Pattern at `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:1186-1297`
   
4. **Circular mean** - Reuse existing function
   - Located at `src/components/Dialogs/SectionPreview.tsx:24-36`
   - Extract to shared utils

5. **Themed Select** - Use existing component as-is
   - Located at `src/components/common/Select.tsx`

### Technical Notes

- **Shot position**: Calculate as `shots.findIndex(s => s.id === shotId) + 1` (1-indexed)
- **Virtual shots**: Include in position count (matches visual display order)
- **Azimuth edit delta**: `newValue - oldMean` applied to both in/out, then normalize 0-360
- **Scroll behavior**: Use `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })` for minimal scroll
- **Edit focus on Enter**: Move focus to same column in next row, auto-enter edit mode

### Dependencies (from epic-scout)

- fn-3-e6v (Display Toggle Visibility) - establishes showShots state
- fn-9-d6v (Section Hover/Selection) - establishes selection sync patterns
- fn-4-7mg (Interaction hitboxes) - clickable shot layers on map
- fn-8-4v9 (Disable pan/zoom interactions) - guards in useMapTools.ts

## Quick commands

```bash
# Run Playwright tests for DataTable
pnpm test:ui --grep "data-table"

# Run type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run dev server to test manually
./scripts/dev.sh
```

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Infinite re-render loops from selection sync | Use derived state, not synced state; use useEffect guards |
| Stale closures in event handlers | Use refs for values needed in callbacks |
| EditableTable breaking changes | Keep existing API, add optional new props |
| Azimuth wrap-around bugs | Use proven circularMean algorithm with normalize |

## Acceptance

- [ ] Selecting shot/station on map switches Data Table to correct section and highlights row
- [ ] Selecting section in Sections Panel switches Data Table dropdown
- [ ] Hovering row in Data Table highlights shot on map immediately
- [ ] Clicking row in Data Table selects shot (appears in Detail Panel)
- [ ] Double-clicking row pans map to center on that shot
- [ ] Section dropdown uses themed Select component
- [ ] ID column shows sectionId:shotPosition format (1-indexed shot position)
- [ ] Detail Panel shot ID matches Data Table format
- [ ] Warnings panel shows sectionId:position format
- [ ] Single "Azi" column with circular mean replaces Azi In/Azi Out
- [ ] Editing Azi offsets both underlying values preserving deviation
- [ ] Length and Depth Out columns don't wrap text
- [ ] Hover row has subtle background, selected row has accent left border
- [ ] Enter/Shift+Enter navigate up/down staying in same column
- [ ] Section deletion switches to first remaining section
- [ ] Shot deletion clears selection
- [ ] Screen reader announces row selection changes

## References

- DataTable component: `src/components/SingleSystemView/DataTable.tsx`
- EditableTable component: `src/components/common/Table.tsx:104-217`
- DetailPanel component: `src/components/SingleSystemView/DetailPanel.tsx`
- Select component: `src/components/common/Select.tsx`
- UI Store selection: `src/store/uiStore.ts:56-99`
- Circular mean function: `src/components/Dialogs/SectionPreview.tsx:24-36`
- Row styling pattern: `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx:218-219`
- Map pan pattern: `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:1186-1297`

## Documentation Updates Needed

- docs/SPEC.md Section 6: Add Data Table Panel specifics
- docs/TESTING.md Section 15.4: Add DataTable test identifiers
- docs/TESTING.md Section 11.2: Add DataTable keyboard navigation
- docs/architecture.md: Add selection sync pattern documentation

# fn-20-mwj.1 Extract shared utilities (circularMean, formatShotId)

## Description
Extract the `circularMeanDegrees` function from SectionPreview.tsx to a shared utils file, and create a new `formatShotId` utility for consistent ID display across components.

**Size:** S
**Files:** 
- `src/utils/angles.ts` (new)
- `src/utils/formatters.ts` (new or add to existing)
- `src/components/Dialogs/SectionPreview.tsx` (update import)

## Approach

1. Create `src/utils/angles.ts` with:
   - `circularMeanDegrees(a: number, b: number): number` - copied from SectionPreview.tsx:24-36
   - `normalizeAngle(degrees: number): number` - normalize to 0-360 range

2. Create `formatShotId` utility:
   - Signature: `formatShotId(sectionId: number, shotPosition: number): string`
   - Returns `${sectionId}:${shotPosition}` (both are 1-indexed for display)
   - Shot position = index in shots array + 1

3. Update SectionPreview.tsx to import from new utils

## Key context

Existing function at `src/components/Dialogs/SectionPreview.tsx:24-36`:
```typescript
function circularMeanDegrees(a: number, b: number): number {
  const aRad = (a * Math.PI) / 180;
  const bRad = (b * Math.PI) / 180;
  const x = (Math.cos(aRad) + Math.cos(bRad)) / 2;
  const y = (Math.sin(aRad) + Math.sin(bRad)) / 2;
  let result = Math.atan2(y, x) * (180 / Math.PI);
  if (result < 0) result += 360;
  return result;
}
```
## Acceptance
- [ ] `circularMeanDegrees` exported from `src/utils/angles.ts`
- [ ] `normalizeAngle` exported from `src/utils/angles.ts`
- [ ] `formatShotId` exported from `src/utils/formatters.ts`
- [ ] SectionPreview.tsx imports from utils instead of local function
- [ ] `circularMeanDegrees(350, 10)` returns ~0 (not 180)
- [ ] `circularMeanDegrees(10, 20)` returns 15
- [ ] `formatShotId(5, 3)` returns "5:3"
- [ ] Type check passes: `pnpm tsc --noEmit`

# fn-20-mwj.4 Implement single azimuth column with circular mean

## Description
Replace the two azimuth columns (Azi In, Azi Out) with a single "Azi" column showing the circular mean. Make it editable with delta-offset behavior.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DataTable.tsx`
- `src/utils/angles.ts` (import)

## Approach

1. Remove columns for `azimuth_in` and `azimuth_out` from columns array

2. Add new "Azi" column:
   - Display: `circularMeanDegrees(shot.azimuth_in, shot.azimuth_out).toFixed(1)`
   - Key: Use virtual key like `_azimuth_avg` (not a real shot field)

3. Custom edit handler for azimuth:
   - Calculate current mean: `currentMean = circularMeanDegrees(shot.azimuth_in, shot.azimuth_out)`
   - Calculate delta: `delta = newValue - currentMean`
   - Apply delta to both: `newIn = normalizeAngle(shot.azimuth_in + delta)`
   - Apply delta to both: `newOut = normalizeAngle(shot.azimuth_out + delta)`
   - Call `updateShot` with both values

4. Update `editableColumns` to include `_azimuth_avg` and handle specially in `handleCellEdit`

## Key context

Circular mean handles wrap-around: 350° and 10° average to ~0°, not 180°.

Edit example: If in=45, out=55 (mean=50), user enters 60:
- delta = 60 - 50 = 10
- newIn = 45 + 10 = 55
- newOut = 55 + 10 = 65
- Mean of 55 and 65 = 60 ✓
## Acceptance
- [ ] Single "Azi" column replaces "Azi In" and "Azi Out" columns
- [ ] Displays circular mean with 1 decimal place (e.g., "123.4")
- [ ] Handles wrap-around: 350° and 10° shows ~0°
- [ ] Column is editable
- [ ] Editing offsets both azimuth_in and azimuth_out by delta
- [ ] Results are normalized to 0-360 range
- [ ] Deviation between in/out is preserved after edit
- [ ] Type check passes: `pnpm tsc --noEmit`

# fn-20-mwj.7 Implement DataTable hover/click/double-click to Map sync

## Description
Implement synchronization from DataTable interactions to Map: row hover highlights shot on map, row click selects shot, double-click pans map to shot.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DataTable.tsx`
- `src/store/uiStore.ts` (add panToShot action)

## Approach

1. **Row hover → Map highlight**:
   - Use new `onRowHover` prop from EditableTable
   - Call `setHoveredShot({ sectionId, shotId })` on hover
   - Call `setHoveredShot(null)` on mouse leave
   - Map already handles `hoveredShot` state for highlighting

2. **Row click → Selection**:
   - Activate the dormant `handleRowClick` (lines 61-69)

   - In MapCanvas, watch for requestPanToShot and call `easeTo()` with shot coordinates

## Key context

Memory pitfall: "Hover state across feature types: When clearing hover state for one feature type, only fire onFeatureHover(false) if no other feature type is currently hovered"

uiStore hover state at lines 175-180:
```tsx
hoveredShot: { sectionId: SectionId; shotId: ShotId } | null;
setHoveredShot: (shot: { sectionId: SectionId; shotId: ShotId } | null) => void;
```

# fn-20-mwj.8 Implement external selection to DataTable sync

## Description
Implement synchronization from external selection (Map, Sections Panel) to DataTable: auto-switch section dropdown, highlight row, scroll row into view.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DataTable.tsx`

## Approach

1. **Watch external selection**:
   - Subscribe to `uiStore.selection` changes
   - When selection changes and is a shot or station, react accordingly

2. **Shot selection sync**:
   - If `selection.type === 'shot'` and `selection.sectionId !== selectedSectionId`:
     - Auto-switch dropdown to `selection.sectionId`
   - Set `scrollToKey` to the shot's ID to trigger scroll

3. **Station selection sync**:
   - If `selection.type === 'station'`:
     - Station N = end of shot N, so highlight shot where `station_index === N`
     - Auto-switch section if needed
     - Scroll to that shot row

4. **Section selection sync**:
   - If `selection.type === 'section'`:
     - Switch dropdown to that section
     - Clear any row highlight (no specific shot selected)

5. **Only sync if open**:
   - Check `dataTableOpen` before syncing
   - If closed, still update `selectedSectionId` for next open

6. **Section dropdown manual change**:
   - When user manually switches dropdown, clear selection and select the new section:
     - `setSelection({ type: 'section', sectionId: newSectionId })`

## Key context

Memory convention: "Concurrency guards at store level (not hook level) when multiple UI paths can trigger the same action"

Selection type at uiStore.ts:56-61:
```tsx
interface Selection {
  type: 'station' | 'shot' | 'section';
  stationRef?: StationRef;
  sectionId?: SectionId;
  shotId?: ShotId;
}
```

Use scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }) for minimal scroll - only scrolls if row not visible.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Selecting shot on map switches DataTable to correct section
- [ ] Selecting shot on map highlights corresponding row
- [ ] Selecting shot on map scrolls row into view (minimal scroll)
- [ ] Selecting station highlights the shot that ends at that station
- [ ] Selecting section in Sections Panel switches DataTable dropdown
- [ ] Section selection clears row highlight
- [ ] Manual dropdown change selects the new section and clears shot selection
- [ ] Sync only happens when DataTable is open (no auto-expand)
- [ ] Type check passes: `pnpm tsc --noEmit`

# fn-20-mwj.9 Handle deletion edge cases and add ARIA announcements

## Description
Handle deletion edge cases (section/shot deletion) and add ARIA live region announcements for screen reader support.

**Size:** S
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DataTable.tsx`
- `src/App.tsx` or appropriate root component (ARIA live region)

## Approach

1. **Section deletion handling**:
   - Watch for changes to `sections` array
   - If `selectedSectionId` no longer exists in sections:
     - Auto-switch to first remaining section: `setSelectedSectionId(sections[0]?.id ?? null)`
   - Use useEffect with sections dependency

2. **Shot deletion handling**:
   - Watch for changes to selected section's shots
   - If selected shot no longer exists:
     - Clear selection: `setSelection(null)` or `clearSelection()`
   - Use useEffect with shots + selection dependency

3. **ARIA announcements**:
   - Add live region at app level (keep mounted permanently per best practice):
     ```tsx
     <div id="selection-announcer" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" className="sr-only" />
     ```
   - When row selection changes, update live region content:
     - "Shot 5:3 selected" (using formatShotId)
   - Use `@react-aria/live-announcer` or manual DOM update

4. **Live region placement**:
   - Add in App.tsx or SingleSystemView.tsx root
   - Use CSS class `sr-only` for visual hiding

## Key context

Memory pitfall: "ARIA live region must exist in DOM before content updates - mount permanently"
Best practice: "Use aria-live='polite' for selection changes (non-urgent)"

CSS sr-only class (typical implementation):
```css
.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  border: 0;
}
```
## Acceptance
- [ ] When current section is deleted, DataTable switches to first remaining section
- [ ] When selected shot is deleted, selection is cleared
- [ ] ARIA live region mounted at app root level
- [ ] Selection changes announce to screen readers (e.g., "Shot 5:3 selected")
- [ ] Announcements use polite priority (don't interrupt)
- [ ] Live region stays mounted (not conditionally rendered)
- [ ] Type check passes: `pnpm tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] Playwright tests pass: `pnpm test:ui`
